crew_quarters.description: Your small bunk room with a metal frame bed and a flickering light. Your toolbag is missing.

objects.description: A note from your shipmate about the missing toolbag.

hallway.description: A long corridor with metal walls. You hear a faint hissing sound coming from the engine room.

machinery_room.description: The Machinery Technician’s workspace, cluttered with tools and blueprints.

storeroom.description: A storage room filled with spare parts and tools.

objects.description: Strong waterproof tape for temporary pipe fixes.
A set of pliers for gripping and cutting.

engine_room.description: A dimly lit room filled with the hum of machinery. A large pipe is hissing steam. The door is locked.

objects.description: A pipe with a slow but steady leak. Needs fixing.
